card.title: I Made the Exception
card.instruction: Treat every exception you once arranged as an unpaid obligation. Casually expect cooperation whenever the old favor becomes relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Since I waived your joining fee, I'd like you to nominate me for treasurer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you back the fee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You repaid money. I made you an exception.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already nominated Ruth. She asked first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ask her to nominate me. You can use your favor with her to settle yours with me.

mechanism: A separates waived-fee exception from repaid money and seeks a nomination through a chain of favors when direct support is already committed.
confusable: Unlike simple financial debt collection, the enduring claim is the special treatment A arranged, not the amount returned.
comparison: The club-election alternative reroutes cooperation through Ruth; the shift alternative turns a disputed one-call effort into the requested manager call.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
